title: Alterant
summary: AL'TERANT, adjective Altering; gradually changing. AL'TERANT, noun A medicine which, without a sensible operation, gradually corrects the state of the body and changes it from a diseased to a healthy

inlines.v: AL'TERANT, adjective Altering; gradually changing. AL'TERANT, noun A medicine which, without a sensible operation, gradually corrects the state of the body and changes it from a diseased to a healthy condition. An alterative.
